note.id: Titik panas dengan keyakinan nominal, tetapi Sentinel-2 hampir tidak menemukan bekas terbakar. Agen mengklaim likely_fire; gerbang bukti menurunkannya ke possible_fire karena luas terukur di bawah 1 ha.
note.en: A nominal-confidence hotspot, but Sentinel-2 finds almost no burn scar. The agent claimed likely_fire; the evidence gate lowered it to possible_fire because the measured burn is under 1 ha.
